spans.s: --born of Anga and father of Diviratha. भा. IX. २३. 6.
--the son of Pramati, (प्रजापति-वि। प्।) and father of चाक्षुष (क्षुप-वा। प्।) (चक्षुष-वि। प्।). भा.
--the son of Rambha, (विवीम्श-Va1. P., Vi. P.) and a righteous king; father of Karamdhama (in Tre- तामुख-वा। प्।), (अतिविभूति-वि। प्।). भा.
